basic_details.job_title: NIT Meghalaya Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 3 Junior Assistant, Technician and More Posts
basic_details.post_name: Junior Assistant, Technician (Dept. of Civil Engg.), Lab Attendant (ME Workshop)
basic_details.short_information: National Institute of Technology Meghalaya (NIT Meghalaya), Sohra, has invited applications for 3 posts in 3 roles. The posts include Junior Assistant, Technician (Dept. of Civil Engg.), Lab Attendant (ME Workshop). The online application is open from 7 November 2026 to 21 December 2026.

application_fee.sc_fee: Exempted, subject to submission of relevant certificate issued by the competent authority

qualification.education_qualification: Junior Assistant: 10+2 with typing speed 35 w.p.m. and computer word processing and spreadsheet proficiency. Technician (Civil): 10+2 Science, or 10+2 with ITI, or 10th with ITI, or Diploma in Civil Engineering. Lab Attendant: 10+2 in Science.

vacancy_details.details: Qualification required: Senior secondary (10+2) from a recognized board with a minimum Typing speed of 35 w.p.m. and proficiency in Computer Word Processing and Spread Sheet. Age limit: Maximum 27 years. Pay: PB: 1 (Rs 5,200 - 20,200) with Grade Pay of Rs 2000. Qualification required: Senior secondary (10+2) with Science from a Government recognized board with at least 60% marks; OR Senior secondary (10+2) from a Government recognized board with at least 50% marks and ITI Course of one year or higher duration in Civil Engineering; OR Secondary (10) with at least 60% marks and ITI Certificate of 2 years duration in Civil Engineering; OR Diploma in Civil Engineering of three year's duration in relevant field from a Government recognized Polytechnic / Institute. Age limit: Maximum 27 years. P

salary_details.pay_scale: PB-1 (Rs 5,200 - 20,200) with Grade Pay Rs 2000 (Junior Assistant, Technician); Grade Pay Rs 1800 (Lab Attendant)

exam_pattern.details: TA / DA will not be paid for attending the Written Test/ skill test/ interview.

how_to_apply: Submit the online application form in the prescribed format available on the Institute's website www.nitm.ac.in.
Upload self-attested copies of the documents listed in the notice along with the application.
Pay the application fee through SBI Collect following the instructions in the 'Check Payment Process' link.
Submit before 11:45 P.M on 21-12-2026; hard copy and offline applications are not accepted.
important_instructions: Fee once paid is not refundable under any circumstances Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification for the post The Institute reserves the right to offer a lower post including entry level post of the cadre to suitable candidates Addendum / corrigendum will be published on www.nitm.ac.in only Queries by e-mail only: [email protected]

content_sections.text: This article is based on the official notification of National Institute of Technology Meghalaya, dated 7 November 2026. Candidates should verify every detail in that notification before applying.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NIT Meghalaya Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 21 December 2026. Applications opened on 7 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NIT Meghalaya Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 Junior Assistant, 1 Technician (Dept. of Civil Engg.), 1 Lab Attendant (ME Workshop).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for NIT Meghalaya Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 21 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: All other candidates (fee printed for the post at Sl. No. 1, Junior Assistant): Rs. 200. SC / ST / PwD / female candidates: Exempted, subject to submission of relevant certificate issued by the competent authority.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 27 years. Relaxation: General Relaxation shall be as per GoI norms; age relaxation shall be made applicable to the eligible departmental candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: PB: 1 (Rs 5,200 - 20,200) with Grade Pay of Rs 2000 for Junior Assistant, PB: 1 (Rs 5,200 - 20,200) with Grade Pay of Rs 2000 for Technician (Dept. of Civil Engg.), PB: 1 (Rs 5,200 - 20,200) with Grade Pay of Rs 1800 for Lab Attendant (ME Workshop).

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Junior Assistant: 10+2 with typing speed 35 w.p.m. and computer word processing and spreadsheet proficiency. Technician (Civil): 10+2 Science, or 10+2 with ITI, or 10th with ITI, or Diploma in Civil Engineering. Lab Attendant: 10+2 in Science. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates in Government / Semi-Government / reputed private institutions should send applications through proper channel; an advance copy may be sent before the last date. Such candidates must produce a No Objection Certificate at the time of interview, failing which they may not be considered. All degree / diploma certificates should be from UGC recognized Universities / Institutes. Selected candidates should be ready to join within the stipulated time.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications not in the prescribed format, or without required documentary proofs, or without application fee will not be considered.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Scrutiny and shortlisting of applications by a duly constituted committee. Test / interview for shortlisted candidates. A duly constituted committee scrutinises applications and fixes the shortlisting criteria. Only shortlisted candidates are communicated for Test / Interview etc. through the Institute's website or e-mail.
